import re
p='/app/submission/main.py'
s=open(p).read()

# change call site
old='''        S = find_fair(set(C))
        if S is not None:
            # construct loop & prefix
            loop = build_loop(S, weak_actions, strong_actions, en_states,
                              edges_by_action, internal_edge, succ, pred)
            prefix = build_prefix(start, next(iter(S)), parentN)
            return False, {"prefix": prefix, "loop": loop}'''

        if S is not None:
            # construct loop & prefix
            root, loop = build_loop(S, weak_actions, strong_actions, en_states,
                                    edges_by_action, internal_edge, succ, pred)
            prefix = build_prefix(start, root, parentN)
            return False, {"prefix": prefix, "loop": loop}'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
